name: reference-driven-3d-character
description: Design and refine editable 3D characters from references, verifying form, deformation, motion, and requested delivery targets.

interface.shortDescription: Design, refine, and verify editable 3D characters
interface.longDescription: Interviews overall composition before new visual work using grill-me when available or focused questions otherwise. Tracks requested image coverage through display, separates concept and native-form reviews, and verifies requested editable delivery. Reuses valid decisions for local repairs.
defaultPrompt: First use grill-me, or the skill's question fallback if unavailable, to ask about the overall composition and required views, details, and motion images. Then create and display the agreed design sheet before building the editable character.
Fix this character's floating facial features while preserving its identity and existing motion.
